text: Job Title: **Customer Experience Lead, Allen Online** Location: Bengaluru, with travel to other locations Reporting to: Head of Customer Experience ** ** Job Description ** ** About ALLEN Digital ** ** Allen Digital is the outcome of a strategic partnership between Allen Careers Institute and Bodhi Tree Systems, which aims to ensure tech enablement for millions of students. Allen Digital seeks to build an EdTech platform that provides students everything a classroom cannot. Allen has the backing of some of the best names in business, education, and technology. With 36+ years of industry leadership, Allen is poised to revolutionise education through its enhanced technology platform. ** ** At Allen, we help students prepare for medical and engineering entrance exams such as the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET), JEE Entrance Examination (JEE Mains & Advanced), and school/board exams, including Olympiads, NTSE, etc. ** ** Role ** ** We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Customer Success Lead to join our team and play a crucial role in driving customer retention and ensuring their success. The ideal candidate will have 8-10 years of experience in customer success, with strong analytical, process-oriented, and leadership skills. This person will work closely with our Academics and Product teams to identify key initiatives that enhance the customer experience, drive retention, and foster long-term success for our customers. #### Key Responsibilities: - Customer Retention Strategy: Develop and implement strategies to drive higher customer retention and satisfaction across the organization. title: Business Analyst
text: **About ALLEN ** Allen is known for fostering academic brilliance with its unwavering commitment to rigorous standards, innovative teaching methodologies, and a nurturing learning environment. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: - Lead the design and implementation of unit and integration tests for mission-critical Go applications within the Identity space. - Perform thorough Code Reviews for fellow engineering team members (including IAM and platform teams), ensuring adherence to best practices in security, performance, and readability. - Architect, build, and maintain testing environments utilizing containerized solutions (Docker) and virtualization (e.g., Tart VMs) to guarantee local developer parity and CI/CD stability. - Develop complex automation and helper tools, utilizing Go and advanced Bash scripting techniques, to streamline testing, deployment, and operational tasks. - Apply deep knowledge of Identity and Access Management (IAM) principles (authentication, authorization, provisioning) to ensure test coverage addresses security and compliance requirements. - Drive code quality across the team, influencing engineering standards and ensuring the final product is reliable, scalable, and maintainable. title: Technology Partnerships Manager – Americas
text: **About Airship** Airship is trusted by world’s leading brands such as Alaska Airlines, BBC and The Home Depot to drive revenue growth and customer loyalty with exceptional cross-channel customer experiences. Today, brands are challenged to deliver seamless, unified customer experiences across a fragmented array of channels and devices— apps, websites, email, SMS, wallets and more. With the ability to easily enrich customer data and rapidly launch growth experiments, Airship enables brands to deliver consistent, meaningful interactions that accelerate conversion and foster deeper customer relationships. We invite you to be part of our journey in building products and delivering services that touch millions of customers around the world every day. To learn more about us, visit [www.airship.com](https://www.airship.com/), read our [blog](https://www.airship.com/blog/) or follow us on [LinkedIn.](https://www.linkedin.com/company/airship-social) #### About the Role The Airship Partnership team drives business relationships with leading technology vendors and agencies to jointly deliver high-impact customer engagement and expand Airship's presence across the MarTech ecosystem. We are hiring a Technology Partnerships Manager for both our Americas and EMEA regions. You will be responsible for managing a portfolio of strategic ISVs (like Google Cloud, Twilio, Salesforce, and leading CDPs, Personalization, Analytics and other MarTech platforms) and driving revenue and market share by sourcing and influencing sales opportunities within your region. You will also be a key bridge between our partners and Airship's Sales, Product, and Marketing teams. #### What You'll Do - **Build and execute a systematic co-sell motion:** define playbooks, identify joint targets with priority tech partners. title: Associate Technical Product Manager, Integrations
text: **Company Introduction:** [Airspace](http://airspace.com) is a tech-enabled freight forwarder that’s redefining how the world’s most critical packages are delivered. Headquartered in Carlsbad, California, Airspace has employees who are based around the world. Our European headquarters is in Amsterdam, The Netherlands. As a recognized leader in AI and machine learning, our team leverages data and patented technology to coordinate logistics across a global network of drivers and airlines. Our goal is to deliver those packages that are truly mission-critical in a way that is faster, more transparent, more secure, and more accountable than ever before. The items we deliver range from organs for transplant, to parts for critical machinery including grounded aircraft and highly sensitive components such as semiconductors. Airspace has been rated one of[ America’s best Startup Employers](https://www.forbes.com/lists/americas-best-startup-employers/?sh=430441b22ad7), listed as one of [CNBC’s Disruptor 50](https://www.cnbc.com/2022/05/17/airspace-disruptor-50.html) companies, and featured as an [Innovation and Disruption leader](https://www.cbsnews.com/video/innovative-technology-is-optimising-the-delivery-of-time-critical-and-life-saving-shipments/) by CBS News. Airspace has the support of leading investors such as Telstra Ventures, HarbourVest Partners, Defy Partners, DBL Partners, and Scale Ventures. To date the company has[ raised more than $140m. ](https://www.cnbc.com/2022/05/25/early-tesla-investor-leads-70-million-investment-in-airspace.html) The company is growing rapidly and serving more places around the world than ever before. We are looking for passionate, motivated individuals who want to make an IMPACT every day to help us execute on our mission of reshaping the world of time-critical logistics. ## **Join the Movement!** Are you interested in the hot logistics technology sector, but also looking for an opportunity to make a direct impact on the lives of others, in some cases saving lives? How about playing a critical role in keeping some of the world's largest companies operating smoothly so cars continuously roll off the assembly line and airlines can keep flights on schedule? ## **About the Role** We are looking for an **Associate Technical Product Manager, Integrations** to own and deliver system integrations between the Airspace platform and our customers' existing technology ecosystems. This role sits between what our customers need and what our platform delivers. You will work directly with customer technical teams to understand their systems, design the right integration approach, and guide our engineers through implementation. You will own the how: how data should flow between systems, how APIs and EDI connections should be structured, how we prototype and validate before we build. You'll work across REST APIs, EDI feeds, TMS platforms, tracking devices, and partner systems to get critical shipment data flowing reliably into Airspace. When you see three customers needing the same thing, you'll identify the pattern and advocate to turn it into a repeatable capability. ## **Responsibilities** ### **Technical product ownership** - Work directly with customer technical teams to understand their systems, data flows, and integration requirements, then design the integration approach that connects their world to Airspace. - Prototype integration concepts to validate approaches early, before committing engineering resources to full implementation. - Evaluate new integration requests and provide technical recommendations. Not just "can we do it" but "here's how we should do it and why." - Define data mapping, API contracts, EDI specifications, and webhook configurations that engineers can build against. ### **Engineering Guidance** - Translate solution designs into clear technical specifications that engineering teams can execute against. You are the bridge between customer requirements and engineering implementation. - Work alongside engineers during development to answer questions, resolve ambiguities, and ensure the implementation matches the designed solution. - Review work-in-progress to catch issues early. You own the integrity of the solution from design through go-live. - Coordinate across internal teams (engineering, data science, operations) and external customer technical teams throughout delivery. ### **Pattern Recognition & Platform Thinking** - Identify repeating integration patterns across customers and recommend platform investments: new public API endpoints, standardized data formats, self-service documentation, and reusable integration templates. - Contribute to an evolving integration playbook that captures proven approaches, lessons learned, and accelerators for future integrations. - Help define what "self-service integration" looks like for Airspace. What documentation, tools, and APIs would enable customers to connect their systems with minimal hands-on support? - Stay current on integration technologies and advocate for modern approaches that reduce implementation time and maintenance burden. ### **Customer & Stakeholder Communication** - Serve as the primary technical point of contact for active integrations. You're the person customers call when they have questions about how the integration works. - Communicate progress, technical decisions, and tradeoffs to internal stakeholders across product, engineering, operations, and customer success. - Keep alignment between what customers expect and what we're delivering. Proactively flag gaps, risks, or opportunities to expand scope. ### **Quality & Go-Live** - Own the integration validation process. Define test plans, coordinate UAT with customers, and ensure integrations work correctly before go-live. - Establish quality standards for integration deployments, including data validation, error handling, and performance benchmarks. - Monitor integration health post-deployment and drive resolution of data quality or connectivity issues. - Create and maintain documentation for each integration: technical specifications, data mapping guides, operational runbooks, and troubleshooting procedures. ## **Requirements** - **2+ years of experience designing and delivering system integrations** in a SaaS, logistics technology, or enterprise software environment. You've owned the "how," not just the timeline. - **Hands-on experience with integration technologies**: REST APIs, EDI, webhooks, data mapping, ETL processes. You don't need to write production code, but you need to be able to read an API spec, sketch a data flow, and prototype a connection. - **Demonstrated ability to work directly with customer technical teams** to understand their systems and design integration approaches. Not just gathering requirements, but co-designing solutions. - **Strong technical communication skills.** Comfortable whiteboarding with engineers, presenting to customers, and writing specs that both audiences can follow. - **Experience guiding engineering teams through implementation of your designs. **You know how to write a spec that doesn't leave engineers guessing. - **Ability to manage multiple concurrent integrations at different stages.** You maintain clarity on priorities and status across projects. - **Strong documentation instincts.** If it's not written down, it didn't happen. - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, or a related field required. ## **Preferred Qualifications** - Experience in logistics, supply chain, or transportation technology. - Familiarity with TMS (Transportation Management System) platforms and logistics data standards. - Experience prototyping integration concepts or building proof-of-concept implementations. - Experience in healthcare logistics or medical device supply chain integrations. - Familiarity with modern API design practices and developer experience (API documentation, SDKs, self-service tooling). ## **Compensation & Benefits** - Salary range: $70K - $100K - High-quality health, dental, and vision plan options - Open PTO - 401K with company match **Core Values:** - **We are One Team**. We believe we all accomplish more when we are working together. - **We make an Impact**. We are determined to have a positive influence on our environment, our customers, our industry, and our world. - **We are Passionate**. We care deeply about our mission and are not afraid to raise the bar. - **We are Transparent**. We pride ourselves on having open, honest, and sincere communication with our team and customers. - **We are Innovative**. We never settle and are always striving to improve our product, service, and ourselves. #### **About Airspace:** From life-saving organs to essential machinery components, Airspace is trusted by the world’s largest companies and most critical healthcare organizations to move their most time-sensitive shipments on time, every time. Our proprietary AI-powered platform is the most advanced of its kind- awarded and protected by multiple patents, it provides speed, reliability, and transparency unrivaled in time-critical logistics. We are thinkers, builders, and doers; from building and deploying AI in the world to assembling a world-class operations team, Airspace is on a hypergrowth trajectory while remaining hyper-focused on the needs of our customers and team members. With offices in the United States in Carlsbad, CA and in Europe in Amsterdam, Frankfurt, Stockholm, and London, we are rapidly scaling into new markets and industries while continuing to innovate and maximize value for our customers. Backed by leading investors including Telstra, HarbourVest, Prologis, Qualcomm, Defy, and others, Airspace has raised $140M to date. Join our team of 300+ technologists, futurists, and industry veterans as we work as One Team to revolutionize time-critical logistics. Airspace is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Additionally, Airspace participates in the E-Verify program for all locations. For this role the acquisition of recruitment agencies is not appreciated, thank you for your understanding.

You will work directly with Airspace's CEO, CFO, CTO, and potentially the Board of Directors, contributing to company-wide materials, investor decks, Board presentations, and executive-level strategic planning. Few roles at this experience level offer this kind of access to the decision-making center of a high-growth, technology-enabled logistics company. text: **Company Introduction:** [Airspace](http://airspace.com) is a tech-enabled freight forwarder that’s redefining how the world’s most critical packages are delivered. Headquartered in Carlsbad, California, Airspace has employees who are based around the world. Our European headquarters is in Amsterdam, The Netherlands. As a recognized leader in AI and machine learning, our team leverages data and patented technology to coordinate logistics across a global network of drivers and airlines. Our goal is to deliver those packages that are truly mission-critical in a way that is faster, more transparent, more secure, and more accountable than ever before. The items we deliver range from organs for transplant, to parts for critical machinery including grounded aircraft and highly sensitive components such as semiconductors. Airspace has been rated one of[ America’s best Startup Employers](https://www.forbes.com/lists/americas-best-startup-employers/?sh=430441b22ad7), listed as one of [CNBC’s Disruptor 50](https://www.cnbc.com/2022/05/17/airspace-disruptor-50.html) companies, and featured as an [Innovation and Disruption leader](https://www.cbsnews.com/video/innovative-technology-is-optimising-the-delivery-of-time-critical-and-life-saving-shipments/) by CBS News. Airspace has the support of leading investors such as Telstra Ventures, HarbourVest Partners, Defy Partners, DBL Partners, and Scale Ventures. To date the company has[ raised more than $140m. ](https://www.cnbc.com/2022/05/25/early-tesla-investor-leads-70-million-investment-in-airspace.html) The company is growing rapidly and serving more places around the world than ever before. We are looking for passionate, motivated individuals who want to make an IMPACT every day to help us execute on our mission of reshaping the world of time-critical logistics. **Overview** *Primary Focus: *To set up all new orders containing the most time-sensitive commodities for success, provide proactive updates to customers on any deviations and track order status progression from start to finish. These job requirements were carefully crafted in order to provide you with the basic building blocks of the Airspace Operations team and pave the way for a continued path forward as you grow within this company. **Importance of Role** The operations team is the backbone of our company and by working on the front lines you represent, first-hand, everything that we stand for. Not only will you be in direct communication with our customers, commanders and agent service providers, with extreme attention to detail, having the ability to catch something so small can ultimately be the difference maker in being able to save a human life! **Responsibilities** *Advanced Problem Solving* - Ability to independently resolve all escalated issues using provided resources with minimal to no assistance - Ability to assist in resolving team member escalations and questions - Understand Margin vs Total Cost for an order and apply knowledge to additional charge approvals - Expert on all International regulations, Import, and Export requirements - Ability to understand big picture decisions for customers balancing service with customer margins. Ability to balance speed, cost, and customer impact without defaulting to escalations - IE. Choosing one airline because we have a service agreement for faster offloads and minimal service failures over the fastest or cheapest option based on error rate. - Balancing cost of service quality and expectations with margin. - Minimal to no errors & service failures - Make educated decisions under pressure - Anticipate problems before they surface and act early *Operating the Airspace Platform* - Hold and maintain Dangerous Goods Certification. Remain knowledgeable on all Dangerous Goods requirements and adhere to current policy procedures. - Assist in resolving team member inquiries for DG flagged orders - Gain knowledge of additional sector processes - Provide SOP guidance hand in hand with leadership - Uphold team expectations leading by example *Maintaining Balanced Level of Performance* As an OSIII, you will be expected to meet minimum metric requirements and customer service standards. Expectations will increase with each advancement. All expectations will be communicated to you through your direct reporting supervisor. Must be able to perform all Responsibilities included in the Operations Specialist II Job Description **Compensation** £48,000 - £61,000 annual salary **Core Values:** - **We are One Team**. We believe we all accomplish more when we are working together. - **We make an Impact**. We are determined to have a positive influence on our environment, our customers, our industry, and our world. - **We are Passionate**. We care deeply about our mission and are not afraid to raise the bar. - **We are Transparent**. We pride ourselves on having open, honest, and sincere communication with our team and customers. - **We are Innovative**. We never settle and are always striving to improve our product, service, and ourselves. #### **About Airspace:** From life-saving organs to essential machinery components, Airspace is trusted by the world’s largest companies and most critical healthcare organizations to move their most time-sensitive shipments on time, every time. Our proprietary AI-powered platform is the most advanced of its kind- awarded and protected by multiple patents, it provides speed, reliability, and transparency unrivaled in time-critical logistics. We are thinkers, builders, and doers; from building and deploying AI in the world to assembling a world-class operations team, Airspace is on a hypergrowth trajectory while remaining hyper-focused on the needs of our customers and team members. With offices in the United States in Carlsbad, CA and in Europe in Amsterdam, Frankfurt, Stockholm, and London, we are rapidly scaling into new markets and industries while continuing to innovate and maximize value for our customers. Backed by leading investors including Telstra, HarbourVest, Prologis, Qualcomm, Defy, and others, Airspace has raised $140M to date. Join our team of 300+ technologists, futurists, and industry veterans as we work as One Team to revolutionize time-critical logistics. Airspace is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Additionally, Airspace participates in the E-Verify program for all locations. For this role the acquisition of recruitment agencies is not appreciated, thank you for your understanding.

Le ou la Consultant·e en Production Intégrée agit en tant que partenaire clé du client, faisant preuve d’un fort leadership, de rigueur, de sens des responsabilités et d’une vision stratégique pour les comptes qui lui sont confiés. S’appuyant sur une expertise approfondie en production vidéo, photographie et post-production, ce rôle crée de la valeur à la fois pour le client et pour APR en accompagnant les marques et leurs agences dans l’optimisation des budgets et des méthodes de production de contenus marketing. La personne idéale développera et renforcera les relations avec les clients et les interlocuteurs en agence afin de garantir que tous les appels d’offres de production respectent les directives et attentes des clients. **Responsabilités principales** La responsabilité générale du poste est d’assurer la gestion réussie de toutes les productions publicitaires :TV, vidéo en ligne et contenus sociaux, formats courts et longs, projets scénarisés ou non, avec des partenaires multiples créatifs. - Vous faites partie d’une équipe de consultants en production et travaillez directement avec les clients, leurs partenaires de production, les agences et les équipes internes afin de maintenir les standards de production, évaluer les prestataires, contrôler les coûts, revoir les calendriers et les approches de production dans une logique de gestion des risques, tout en tenant compte de la culture et des besoins du client. Vous accompagnez le client en tant qu’expert reconnu, en veillant à ce que toutes les exigences soient pleinement satisfaites et que les standards soient respectés. - Vous facilitez la communication entre le client et ses partenaires afin d’assurer le bon déroulement des productions, identifiez les problèmes de process et proposez des solutions à fort impact. Vous comprenez les objectifs marketing et de production et gérez simultanément plusieurs projets et/ou clients. Vous soutenez et développez les relations clients afin d’aider les marques à atteindre leurs objectifs commerciaux. - Le ou la Consultant·e en Production Intégrée doit comprendre le rôle de APR tout au long du projet, du brief client à la livraison finale, et utiliser son expertise pour conseiller sur tous les aspects de la production. - Vous collaborez avec les membres de l’équipe et/ou des expert·e·s dans d’autres domaines pour mener à bien les projets. - Vous êtes capable d’identifier les problématiques spécifiques à la production et de contribuer à la mise en place de solutions adaptées. **Responsabilités clés** - Gérer les interactions quotidiennes avec le client et l’agence sur les projets. - Comprendre la méthodologie d’optimisation des coûts de APR et identifier les catégories d’efficacité appropriées. - Instaurer une communication transparente et une relation de confiance avec le client et l’agence. - Soutenir et développer les relations clients afin de les aider à atteindre leurs objectifs commerciaux. - Faire respecter la politique des clients, les directives de production et les bonnes pratiques. - Identifier les problèmes des processus de production et proposer des solutions à fort impact. **Responsabilités liées aux projets** - Lancer les projets et agir comme point de liaison pour les informations de production entre l’agence et le client. - Évaluer les prestataires de production pressentis en termes de qualité et de valeur. - Participer aux réunions de pré-bid afin d’aligner le périmètre du projet avec l’agence et le client (créative, calendrier, lieux de tournage, spécifications, budget). Ces réunions incluent également les prestataires sollicités. - Collecter tous les devis, les traitements créatifs, les lettres de soumission et les calendriers à revoir. - Comparer et revoir ces éléments et préparer des recommandations pour l’agence et/ou le client. - Fournir des commentaires aux clients, agences et prestataires sur les propositions. - Négocier les devis et estimations des prestataires afin d’obtenir la meilleure valeur. - Identifier et documenter les économies réalisées et/ou les bénéfices apportés par APR. - Revalider l’exactitude du périmètre du projet. - Revoir l’estimation de l’agence afin de s’assurer que tous les coûts négociés sont bien inclus. - Communiquer au client l’ensemble des coûts proposés et les bénéfices générés par APR. - Participer award meetings de projet. - Assister aux réunions de pré-production lorsque requis. - Suivre le projet tout au long de la production, de la post-production et jusqu’à la livraison, en surveillant les écarts et dépassements. - Identifier les problématiques et solutions de procès spécifiques à chaque projet. - Fournir un rapport de synthèse à la fin de chaque projet. **Responsabilités de reporting** - Assurer que toutes les estimations, correspondances et informations pertinentes sont enregistrées dans la base de données de suivi de projets de APR. - Documenter les problématiques et solutions propres aux projets et les intégrer dans la base de données de APR. - Contribuer aux rapports trimestriels et annuels des clients. **Profil recherché** - Situé·e à Paris et bilingue français / anglais. - Dix ans d’expérience approfondie en production de contenus publicitaires au sein d’une société de production. - Expérience significative avec des marques de beauté, de luxe ou de mode. - Expérience dans la réponse à des appels d’offres de production publicitaire. - Une expérience en agence publicitaire et/ou chez le client peut également être considérée. - Expérience de consultance est recommandée. - Expérience de travail direct avec des agences créatives ainsi qu’avec des équipes marketing et achats des clients. - Capacité à influencer, impacter et guider les autres sur des projets d’importance critique. - Excellentes capacités d’analyse et de réflexion critique. - Excellentes compétences en communication orale et écrite. - Autonome, motivé·e, passionné·e, capable de travailler efficacement sans supervision quotidienne. APR valorise une culture inclusive, nourrie par nos points de vue uniques ainsi que la diversité de nos parcours et expériences. **Note :** Cette description de poste n’a pas vocation à être une liste exhaustive de toutes les tâches, responsabilités ou qualifications associées au poste. D’autres missions pourront être confiées par le/la superviseur(e). Veuillez nous faire parvenir votre CV et votre lettre de motivation (optionnelle) en anglais.

title: Consultant, Integrated
text: **CONSULTANT, INTEGRATED ** **PURPOSE ** APR Consulting Co is a strategic production consultancy at the forefront of the advertising industry and is seeking a Consultant, Integrated based in Japan to join our APAC team. With over 180 strategic advisors worldwide, APR Consulting Co offers unparalleled expertise in production efficiency across local, regional, and international markets, empowering global Fortune 500 marketers to maximize ROI while safeguarding the creative integrity of their projects through APR’s strategic consulting approach. We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive project-based Production Advisor to conduct agency fee and production reviews, oversee production-related financials, manage client relationships, and ensure seamless project reporting. This role combines production expertise with strong account management skills to support motion, still, and digital campaigns across multiple clients. Advisor must be capable of representing APR in 1:1 conversations in Japanese with local, senior agency, and client partners. The Consultant, Integrated, will utilize their extensive experience in video production and agency fee structures in the Japanese market to manage advertising production across broadcast, online video, social content, and both long- and short-form formats, scripted and unscripted, working with multiple creative partners. The candidate is fluent in Japanese and English, with proven knowledge and experience in still photography and video production, experience working with production houses in Japan, agency resource rates and production cost evaluations. **DEFINING SUCCESS FOR THIS ROLE **This position will be successful if they can demonstrate the following objectives and performance targets: - Manage advertising production cost reviews across all formats, ensuring quality, cost efficiency, and risk mitigation while leveraging deep knowledge of Japanese market practices. - Foster strong client and agency partnerships, facilitate clear communication, and resolve process issues with impactful solutions. - Drive savings through APR methodologies, oversee accurate reporting and data entry, and share insights to elevate team and client expertise. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES **This position’s key responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following: - Manage day-to-day client/agency interactions and keep senior team members informed. - Identify and resolve project issues; enforce client policies, guidelines, and best practices. - Act as liaison between agency and client; kick off projects and attend key meetings. - Provide executional ballparks, identify opportunities to repurpose assets, and vet vendors for quality and value. - Collect, review, and analyze bids, treatments, and schedules; provide feedback and negotiate for best value. - Align scope, budget, and specifications; confirm accuracy and communicate costs and APR-derived benefits to clients. - Monitor projects through all phases (pre-production, production, post-production), track changes, and prevent overages. - Capture savings, process issues, and solutions; contribute to project summaries and reports. - Maintain documentation for data entry and participate in awards and project closeout. - Ensure all production estimates, bids, and invoices align with internal guidelines and industry standards. - Communicate project updates, timelines, and deliverables in a clear and timely manner. - Coordinate with internal teams and external partners to ensure client expectations are met. - Support client relationships, foster transparent communication, and help achieve business objectives. - Track and report all project progress in accordance with the Japan methodology. - Provide timely updates to senior management on project performance and key milestones. - Prepare and review summary reports; contribute to project roll-ups and quarterly/annual reporting. - Track project work hours in Deltek and monitor compliance with processes. **ABOUT YOU ** - 10+ years in advertising production, including TV commercials (Line/Executive Producer roles). - Fluent in Japanese and English, both written and verbal. - Ideally worked with or for a Japanese creative agency with experience still and video shoots. - Strong knowledge of video production, agency fee structures, and bidding; experience across client, agency, and vendor environments from ideally having worked in agency networks in Japan. - Experience in production, account management, or related fields (advertising, creative agencies, content production). - Strong understanding of production processes for motion and still campaigns. - Excellent communication - written and verbal, organizational, and problem-solving skills. - Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining high attention to detail. - Collaborative, diplomatic, and influential - Tech-savvy with proficiency in MS Office, Teams, SharePoint, Zoom, and Google tools. - Independent, self-motivated, and detail-oriented. - Global Contractors: Extensive knowledge of individual and/or regional market labor, equipment, vendor, and talent rules and rates. **WHY JOIN APR? ** Flexible Schedule: Enjoy a flexible schedule within our remote, global team. We prioritize your well-being, offering you the freedom to find a work-life balance that works for YOU. Dynamic Team Culture: Be part of a vibrant, collaborative team where enthusiasm, proactivity, inclusivity, curiosity, and authenticity are at the core of our values. Cutting-Edge Innovation: Engage with a team dedicated to pushing the boundaries in marketing & advertising operations. If you’re passionate about driving innovation, this is the place for you. Career Advancement: Benefit from continuous learning opportunities and career growth within a growing company. Work closely with top-tier teams and clients, gaining practical experience and deepening your expertise in production efficiency. Global Influence: Contribute to the future of marketing for prominent global brands. At APR, we lead the charge in sustainability and exceptional client support, giving you a chance to make a significant impact on a global scale. APR values an inclusive workforce and culture driven by our unique viewpoints and diverse background and experiences. **Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) ** The Company is committed to equal employment opportunity and to compliance with federal and state antidiscrimination laws. We prohibit discrimination and harassment against any employees or applicants based on race, color, creed, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity and transgender, familial status, national origin, disability, genetic information, age 40 and over, veteran status, military status, marital status, domestic violence victim status, or any other status protected by applicable state or local law. This policy governs all stages of employment including application. Note: This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities or qualifications associated with the job. Other duties may be assigned by management.

title: Erzieher – Bilingualer Kindergarten - (m/w/d)
text: ### Dein Job - **Sprachvorbild sein: **Du begleitest Kinder im Alter von 1 - 6 Jahren bis zum Schuleintritt auf Deutsch und unterstützt sie spielerisch beim natürlichen Spracherwerb. - **Pädagogische Arbeit gestalten: **Du entwickelst kreative Bildungsangebote, die auf die individuellen Interessen, Bedürfnisse und Altersstufen der Kinder abgestimmt sind – immer im Sinne unseres bilingualen Konzepts. - **Ganzheitlich fördern: **Du begleitest die Kinder in ihrer sprachlichen, motorischen, emotionalen und sozialen Entwicklung und stärkst ihre Selbstständigkeit. - **Kulturelle Vielfalt leben: **Du vermittelst interkultureller Werte und schaffst ein offenes, wertschätzendes Umfeld, in dem sich jedes Kind willkommen fühlt. - **Elternarbeit pflegen: **Du führst vertrauensvolle Gespräche mit Eltern und informierst sie regelmäßig über die Entwicklung ihrer Kinder. - **Teamarbeit leben: **Du arbeitest eng mit deutschsprachigen Kollegen zusammen und gestaltest gemeinsam eine harmonische, zweisprachige Lernumgebung. - **Dokumentation & Beobachtung: **Du beobachtest und dokumentierst die Entwicklungsschritte der Kinder und reflektierst deine pädagogische Arbeit regelmäßig. - **Schutz und Geborgenheit geben: **Du sorgst für eine liebevolle, sichere und fördernde Atmosphäre, in der sich Kinder aller Altersgruppen wohlfühlen. - text: ### Dein Job - **Leidenschaft teilen: **Du gibst deine Begeisterung für Mathematik mitreißend an Schülerinnen und Schüler weiter. - **Unterricht lebendig gestalten: **Du entwickelst motivierenden, praxisnahen Unterricht für die Sekundarstufen I & II. - **Kompetenzen stärken: **Du vermittelst mathematisches Denken, logisches Argumentieren und Problemlösefähigkeiten. - **Zukunft vorbereiten:** Du machst Jugendliche fit für die MSA und Abiturprüfungen und die Herausforderungen von morgen. - **Digital unterrichten: **Du nutzt moderne Methoden und digitale Medien sinnvoll und zielgerichtet im Mathematikunterricht. - **Kreativität einbringen: **Du entwickelst eigene Unterrichtskonzepte und setzt diese abwechslungsreich um. - **Individuell fördern: **Du erkennst Lernbedarfe und gestaltest differenzierten Unterricht für alle Leistungsniveaus. - **Leistung bewerten: **Du erstellst faire Leistungsnachweise und begleitest Lernprozesse konstruktiv. - **Im Dialog sein: **Du führst Gespräche mit Schülerinnen, Schülern und Eltern offen und lösungsorientiert. - **Schulleben mitgestalten: **Du bringst dich aktiv in Projekte, Fachgruppen und Konferenzen ein. - **Mathematik erlebbar machen:** Du unterstützt Wettbewerbe, Exkursionen oder Projekte, die die Freude an Mathematik fördern. - **Teamarbeit leben: **Du arbeitest gerne im Kollegium zusammen und entwickelst Unterricht und Lernkonzepte gemeinsam weiter. ### Deine Qualifikation - **Fachlich qualifiziert: **Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Lehramtsstudium mit Zweiter Staatsprüfung *oder* eine gültige Unterrichtsgenehmigung des Landes Brandenburg für die Sekundarstufe I und/oder II im Fach Mathematik. - **Unterrichtserfahren: **Du verfügst über mehrjährige Lehrerfahrung, idealerweise auch im gymnasialen Bildungsgang oder an einer Gemeinschaftsschule. - **Mathematisch versiert: **Du bringst fundierte Kenntnisse in Analysis, Algebra, Geometrie und Stochastik mit – und hast Freude daran, komplexe Inhalte verständlich zu vermitteln. - **Strukturiert und zuverlässig: **Du planst Unterricht sorgfältig, arbeitest organisiert und behältst auch bei anspruchsvollen Themen den Überblick. - **Kommunikativ und klar: **Du drückst dich mündlich wie schriftlich sicher aus (mind. C1-Niveau) und kommunizierst wertschätzend, verständlich und zielgruppenorientiert. - **Innovativ im Unterricht: **Du nutzt digitale Medien sinnvoll, setzt moderne Methoden ein und hast Interesse an neuen didaktischen und technologischen Entwicklungen. - **Mitgestalten statt nur verwalten: **Du möchtest dich engagiert in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Schule einbringen und Veränderungsprozesse aktiv begleiten. - **Teamplayer: **Du arbeitest gerne kollegial zusammen, unterstützt die Fachschaft Mathematik und entwickelst Unterrichtsideen gemeinsam weiter. ### Unsere Benefits - **Sicheres Arbeitsverhältnis** – Wir bieten Dir einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag in einer offenen, kollegialen und motivierenden Teamkultur. - **Raum zur individuellen Ausgestaltung des Unterrichts:** Du hast die Möglichkeit, Deinen Unterricht kreativ und selbstbestimmt zu gestalten und auf die Bedürfnisse Deiner Schüler*innen einzugehen. - **Internationale Schulpartnerschaften:** Du profitierst von der Teilnahme an internationalen Schulpartnerschaften und förderst interkulturelle Zusammenarbeit und Austausch. - **Digital ausgestattete Schulen:** Du arbeitest in modernen, digital gut ausgestatteten Schulen, die den Einsatz neuer Technologien im Unterricht unterstützen. - **Gemeinsame Erlebnisse: **Du kannst Dich auf regelmäßige Firmenevents freuen, die den Teamgeist stärken und für abwechslungsreiche, gemeinsame Erlebnisse sorgen. - **Individuelle Weiterentwicklung: **Wir unterstützen und fördern Deine fachliche sowie persönliche Weiterentwicklung mit gezielten Weiterbildungsangeboten. - **Attraktive Vergünstigungen: **Du profitierst von exklusiven Mitarbeiterangeboten - **Gesundheitsförderung: **Mit einer Urban Sports Club Firmenmitgliedschaft kannst Du Deine sportliche Aktivität jederzeit flexibel und günstig gestalten.

C1-Niveau). - **Modern und innovativ: **Du nutzt digitale Medien kompetent, erkennst neue pädagogische und technologische Entwicklungen und setzt moderne Unterrichtskonzepte kreativ um. - **Gestaltungsfreude: **Du möchtest Schulentwicklung aktiv mitprägen und Veränderungen konstruktiv begleiten. - **Teamorientiert: **Du arbeitest gern mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen zusammen und bringst dich verlässlich in die Fachschaft ein. ### Unsere Benefits - **Sicheres Arbeitsverhältnis** – Wir bieten Dir einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag in einer offenen, kollegialen und motivierenden Teamkultur. - **Raum zur individuellen Ausgestaltung des Unterrichts:** Du hast die Möglichkeit, Deinen Unterricht kreativ und selbstbestimmt zu gestalten und auf die Bedürfnisse Deiner Schüler*innen einzugehen. - **Internationale Schulpartnerschaften:** Du profitierst von der Teilnahme an internationalen Schulpartnerschaften und förderst interkulturelle Zusammenarbeit und Austausch. - **Digital ausgestattete Schulen:** Du arbeitest in modernen, digital gut ausgestatteten Schulen, die den Einsatz neuer Technologien im Unterricht unterstützen. - **Gemeinsame Erlebnisse: **Du kannst Dich auf regelmäßige Firmenevents freuen, die den Teamgeist stärken und für abwechslungsreiche, gemeinsame Erlebnisse sorgen. - **Individuelle Weiterentwicklung: **Wir unterstützen und fördern Deine fachliche sowie persönliche Weiterentwicklung mit gezielten Weiterbildungsangeboten. - **Attraktive Vergünstigungen: **Du profitierst von exklusiven Mitarbeiterangeboten - **Gesundheitsförderung: **Mit einer Urban Sports Club Firmenmitgliedschaft kannst Du Deine sportliche Aktivität jederzeit flexibel und günstig gestalten.

title: Lehrkraft Gesellschaftswissenschaften für die Sekundarstufe II (m/w/d)

**Kompetenzen stärken: **Du förderst kritisches Denken, Urteilsvermögen und die Fähigkeit zur reflektierten Meinungsbildung. - **Zukunft vorbereiten:** Du begleitest Jugendliche dabei, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und sich in einer komplexen Welt orientieren zu können. - **Digital unterrichten: **Du nutzt moderne Methoden und digitale Medien sinnvoll und zielgerichtet im Unterricht. - **Kreativität einbringen: **Du entwickelst eigene Unterrichtskonzepte und setzt diese abwechslungsreich, interaktiv und diskussionsorientiert um. - **Individuell fördern: **Du gehst auf unterschiedliche Sichtweisen ein und schaffst Raum für respektvollen Austausch und persönliche Entwicklung. - **Leistung bewerten: **Du gestaltest faire und transparente Bewertungsverfahren und begleitest Lernprozesse konstruktiv. - **Im Dialog sein: **Du führst Gespräche mit Schülerinnen, Schülern und Eltern offen, empathisch und lösungsorientiert. - **Schulleben mitgestalten: **Du bringst dich aktiv in Projekte, Fachgruppen und Konferenzen ein. - **Werte erfahrbar machen: **Du unterstützt schulische Projekte zu Themen wie Demokratie, Toleranz, Nachhaltigkeit oder interkulturellem Lernen. - **Teamarbeit leben: **Du arbeitest gerne im Kollegium zusammen und entwickelst den Ethikunterricht gemeinsam weiter. ### Deine Qualifikation - **Abschluss: **Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Lehramtsstudium mit Zweiter Staatsprüfung oder eine Unterrichtsgenehmigung durch das Thüringer Ministerium - **Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeiten: **Du verfügst über eine sehr gute sprachliche Ausdrucksfähigkeit in Wort und Schrift (mindestens C1, idealerweise C2-Niveau) und kommunizierst klar, empathisch und respektvoll. - **Pädagogische Kompetenz: **Du hast Erfahrung in der Planung und Durchführung von Unterrichtseinheiten sowie in der Begleitung von Schülerinnen und Schülern in ihrer persönlichen und werteorientierten Entwicklung. - **Interesse an Philosophie, Ethik und Gesellschaft: **Du begeisterst dich für ethische Fragestellungen, gesellschaftliche Zusammenhänge und Wertebildung – und schaffst es, diese Themen lebendig und zugänglich zu vermitteln. - **Kreativität und Eigeninitiative: **Du bringst Kreativität, Eigeninitiative und den Mut mit, neue Wege im Ethikunterricht zu gehen und aktuelle Themen in deinen Unterricht zu integrieren. - **Offenheit für Neues: **Du nutzt digitale Medien und innovative Unterrichtskonzepte gezielt, um einen modernen, schülerzentrierten Unterricht zu gestalten, und begegnest neuen Aufgaben mit Engagement und positiver Haltung. - **Engagement in der Schulentwicklung: **Du beteiligst dich aktiv an der Weiterentwicklung unserer Schule und bringst dich in Projekte rund um Wertevermittlung, soziales Lernen und interkulturelle Bildung ein. - **Reflexions- und Innovationsgeist: **Du denkst kritisch, reflektiert und zukunftsorientiert und hast Freude daran, neue pädagogische und gesellschaftliche Impulse in den Unterricht zu integrieren. - **Internationale Offenheit: **Idealerweise bringst du Erfahrung aus interkulturellen oder internationalen Bildungskontexten mit und förderst so das globale Bewusstsein deiner Schülerinnen und Schüler. ### Unsere Benefits - **Gemeinsame Erlebnisse: **Du kannst Dich auf regelmäßige Firmenevents freuen, die den Teamgeist stärken und für abwechslungsreiche, gemeinsame Erlebnisse sorgen. - **Individuelle Weiterentwicklung: **Wir unterstützen und fördern Deine fachliche sowie persönliche Weiterentwicklung mit gezielten Weiterbildungsangeboten. - title: Lerntherapeuten (m/w/d)

text: ### Dein Job **Unsere Super-Schulen: ** • Ganztagsschulen mit großem Angebot an Arbeitsgemeinschaften • Schulen in grüner Umgebung • Kleine Klassen mit max. 25 Schülern • Unterstützendes Team aus Sonder- und Sozialpädagogen • Internationale Schulpartnerschaften • Digital ausgestattete Schulen | Moderne Fachkabinette • Tablets (Grundschulen) und Laptops (weiterführende Schulen) für Schüler • Hervorragende Berufs- und Studienorientierung • Schulen ohne Rassismus • Aktives Eltern-Lehrer-Verhältnis ### Deine Qualifikation **Das ist unser Super-Lehrer! ** Sie bringen individuelle Fähigkeiten mit, die wir kennenlernen wollen und zum Weiterentwickeln Ihrer neuen Schule nutzen möchten. Begeistern Sie uns mit Ihrer Kreativität zum Unterrichten! • Sie können mehr als nur Unterricht nach Schema F abhalten. • Digitalisierung in Schulen ist für Sie selbstverständlich. • Beim Vermitteln von Wissen gehen Sie über den klassischen Unterricht hinaus. • Dabei begegnen Sie unseren Schülern stets mit Respekt. • Sie erkennen Potenziale und fordern, ohne zu überfordern. • Sie bewahren auch in schwierigen Situationen einen kühlen Kopf. • Sie sind im gesamten Schulalltag Ansprechpartner für kleine und große Probleme. • Sie unterstützen die Entwicklung einer neuen jungen Generation mit allem, was Sie zu bieten haben. • Und wenn es darauf ankommt, sind Sie auch mal das Kryptonit und setzen Grenzen. **Wenn Sie sich wiedererkannt haben, dann kann Ihr Weg nur zu uns nach Brandenburg führen: in die Schulen der FAWZ!** **Der Super-Quereinsteiger!** Sie haben Ihre Superkräfte bisher in der Wirtschaft gezeigt und sind jetzt bereit, Ihr Wissen weiterzugeben? Bleiben Sie Ihrer Qualifikation treu und werden bei uns Fachlehrer auf Ihrem Spezialgebiet. Für den idealen Einstieg in Ihren neuen Job bilden wir an unserer Pädagogischen Akademie Ihre didaktischen und pädagogischen Superkräfte aus. Voraussetzung dafür ist mindestens ein abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium ### Unsere Benefits **Unsere Superkräfte für Sie: ** • Unbefristetes Arbeitsverhältnis in Voll- oder Teilzeit • Vergütung in Anlehnung an den TV-L • Urlaubsregelung, vergleichbar mit der an Schulen in öffentlicher Trägerschaft • Unterrichtseinsatz in studierten Fächern • Anrechnungsstunden bei Übernahme von Funktionen • Überstunden-Vergütung für zusätzlichen Unterricht • Raum zur individuellen Ausgestaltung des Unterrichts • Einen abwechslungsreichen und interessanten Arbeitsplatz • Ein freundliches und kollegiales Arbeitsklima **Unsere Supermehrwerte für Sie:** • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge • Betriebliche Unfallversicherung • Betriebliche Krankenzusatzversicherung • Regelmäßige Fort- und Weiterbildungsangebote über unsere Akademie der Bildung • Pädagogische Akademie für Seiteneinsteiger • Betriebliche Mobilität über JobRad • Gesundheitsförderung mit jährlichem Gesundheitstag • Mitarbeiter-Veranstaltungen • Digitale Ausstattung (Laptop, PC o.ä.) title: Software Engineer, Applied AI
text: ABOUT FLORA We are building the first creative operating system: an infinite canvas designed for the generative computing paradigm. We’re a team of ~45 focused on elevating professional craft, backed by tier-one investors including Redpoint, Menlo Ventures, and a16z, as well as founders like Guillermo Rauch and Justin Kan. Our platform is already the choice of world-class creative powerhouses like Pentagram, Lionsgate, and Nike. We’re looking to bring on a Software Engineer who will architect and build the agentic systems powering FLORA. As part of the founding team, you will work closely with the founders to invent how creative professionals interact with AI in a generative age. This is a first-principles role: you’ll design, implement, and scale the backbone of agentic workflows that let creatives orchestrate text, image, and video models seamlessly on FLORA’s infinite canvas. What You’ll Do As an Applied AI Engineer, you’ll design and build the intelligence layer of FLORA — systems that make multi-modal creative workflows powerful, reliable, and intuitive. You’ll work on problems at the intersection of AI, orchestration, and interaction design: bringing together text, image, and video models into seamless workflows that creatives can actually trust and enjoy using. You’ll collaborate across product, infra, and design to build agentic features that let creatives speak their idea into existence while maintaining control. Requirements - Hands-on experience building agentic systems — e.g. multi-step pipelines, tool-using agents, assistants with memory, or similar. - Familiarity with evaluation frameworks (automated checks, regression testing, human-in-the-loop scoring) to ensure system reliability. - Experience with memory and retrieval (vector DBs, embeddings, summarization, context management). - Strong background in orchestration across models, APIs, and tools — including handling retries, fallbacks, and edge cases. - Comfortable reasoning about multi-modal workflows (text, image, video) and their integration in a user-facing product. - Ability to work across the stack (frontend, backend, infra) and collaborate closely with product and design. - Product-minded — you care as much about usability and creative control as you do about technical novelty. - 3+ years of engineering experience - Bonus: experience with creative tools, generative models, or node-based interfaces. WORKING AT FLORA OFFICE POLICY We work in-person at the Domino Refinery building in Williamsburg, Brooklyn—with views of the East River. COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS Competitive salary and meaningful equity. We also offer an Equinox membership and comprehensive health and dental coverage.

text: ABOUT FLORA We are building the first creative operating system: an infinite canvas designed for the generative computing paradigm. ABOUT THE ROLE Creative teams everywhere are rethinking how they concept, design, and produce in a generative age—but many need a trusted partner to help bridge the potential of AI and the practical realities of the creative process. As a Forward Deployed Creative, you’ll bridge creative potential and practical adoption. This is a hybrid role spanning roughly 70% Customer Success / Sales, 20% Marketing, and 10% Product. You’ll guide world-class creative teams to success, create content that inspires, and bring insights directly back into the product. HOW YOU’LL MAKE AN IMPACT Customer Success / Sales Enablement - Partner with Sales on calls to demonstrate FLORA’s creative and business value. - Design and lead workshops that teach teams how to integrate FLORA into their processes. - Build custom FLORA workflows tailored to customer’s creative briefs, projects, and use cases. - Support customer onboarding and help teams integrate FLORA into their creative processes. Marketing - Create tutorials, case studies, and campaign content that showcase best practices, creative use cases, and new product launches. - Host livestreams, webinars, and events that inspire the community and demonstrate the power of FLORA in real creative contexts. - Develop workflows, apps, and techniques for FLORA’s community page and content library. - Engage actively across social channels and at events to represent FLORA’s brand and connect with creators worldwide. Product - Synthesize customer feedback to help improve the product. - Work closely with engineering and design to close the loop between user insights and product improvements. Partnerships - Develop and execute strategies to help FLORA reach and engage specific creative industries. - Build relationships with creative leaders and organizations, turning early advocates into long-term partners and champions. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR Domain Expertise & Versatility You’re deeply grounded in a creative domain—whether design, marketing, fashion, film, or beyond. You understand the workflows, pain points, and language of that world, and can speak as a respected peer. At the same time, you’re versatile enough to jump into any customer context or industry and quickly show how FLORA can elevate their process. You naturally experiment, share your discoveries, and can’t help but spread your excitement. You’re a practitioner at heart—someone who learns by doing and constantly pushes what’s possible with generative tools. Customer-Facing Experience You’re a natural communicator—personable, professional, and able to build strong relationships with creative teams. You can connect with customers across industries, understand their needs, and translate them into practical solutions. You love solving problems, teaching others, and enabling creative success. You’re comfortable being the face of FLORA in public settings—presenting on livestreams, at events, and in recorded tutorials. Community You’re an active member of the creative and AI ecosystem and bring both credibility and community with you. You know the conversations, studios, and emerging voices shaping the field, and you can represent FLORA authentically among them. In addition, here are common traits that we look for across all our roles on the GTM team: - Passionate, purpose-led, and all-in. You are obsessed with working towards our vision and spreading it to the world. - Hustle and work ethic. You are known for going the extra mile(s). You roll up your sleeves and consider no task beneath you. - Relentless focus on efficiency and effectiveness. You prioritize the highest-leverage activities that have the highest ROI. - Ownership mindset. You act like an owner - you have the highest standards of accountability for your work and proactively improve anything you see. - Nimble. You iterate continuously (without spinning wheels), execute with an extreme sense of urgency (every minute counts), and dive into new problems & opportunities seamlessly. - High bar for excellence + low ego. You're driven to win at the highest level. You seek and welcome feedback, and do what's best for the company and team. - Service mentality. You constantly think about how you can serve and provide value to others - to customers, partners, and teammates. - Daring. You bring to life bold, original ideas.

title: Base Optimization Specialist
text: Airtable is the no-code app platform that empowers people closest to the work to accelerate their most critical business processes. You won't just advise, you'll get into the base and demonstrate better alternatives. Optimization at Airtable means reshaping how a customer's environment is built so it scales, performs, and unlocks capabilities they couldn't access before. - Frame every recommendation around business impact. Customers need to understand why a restructured base matters to their workflow, not just what changed. You connect architectural decisions to the outcomes their team cares about. - Identify opportunities to expand how customers use the platform, including automation workflows, interfaces for different user personas, and AI capabilities where they add value to the restructured environment. - Surface patterns in which customers consistently outgrow their initial architecture and feed that signal back to product, engineering, and the broader support organization. - Stay current on platform evolution, particularly around AI capabilities, automation architecture, and integration patterns, so your recommendations reflect what the platform can do today. # **Who you are** - You're a builder with an optimization mindset. title: Delivery Consultant
text: Airtable is the no-code app platform that empowers people closest to the work to accelerate their most critical business processes. More than 500,000 organizations, including 80% of the Fortune 100, rely on Airtable to transform how work gets done. Work isn't being replaced. It's being redesigned. Airtable is built for that moment: the same platform humans run their most critical workflows on is where agents now operate alongside them. Professional Services is where that redesign happens. The Delivery Consultant turns a solution vision into systems that achieve outcomes. You build the systems: interfaces, automations, data models, integrations, and you run the customer sessions that close the gap between how the work was designed and how it actually gets done. The two are inseparable: what you learn in the room changes what you build, and what you build is how you earn the room's trust. You work directly with the operators and builders whose jobs are changing. Your judgment about when to evolve the design and when to hold the vision is what determines whether a system achieves what it was designed to do. Getting there requires more than technical skill. You help customers see past what's familiar to what will actually work, present trade-offs with enough clarity and conviction that they can make real decisions, and keep them focused on what matters when everything around them is in motion. Depending on the engagement, you may contribute to solution design, own delivery coordination, or build within a larger team. # **What you'll do** - Run recurring customer sessions with the operators and builders who will live in the system, surfacing the ground-level realities that change what gets built and how. - Build the interfaces, field agents, automations, data models, and integrations that translate a solution vision into working systems. - Make the calls that close the gap between designed and real: when user feedback signals a design issue, bring the solution, not just the flag. - Build efficiently with AI and reinvest the saved time in customer engagement; customer-facing time is actively measured and valued on this team. - QA your own work against how users will actually behave, not just whether automations fire correctly. - Create reusable build patterns that extend impact beyond individual engagements. - Achieve full Airtable platform proficiency within 90 days; advanced work across interfaces, automations, data modeling, and integrations is the baseline expectation. # **Who you are** - AI is embedded in how you build, not something you reach for on select tasks. You use it across every phase of delivery: designing, building, testing, documenting. You can name exactly which tasks you've offloaded to AI, how much time it frees, and where your judgment is what AI can't replace. - 3–5 years in a client-facing delivery or implementation role, with direct accountability for whether systems work in practice, not just whether they shipped. - Hands-on technical depth: you have built complex systems with forms, automations, integrations, and data models, and you understand the tradeoffs at each layer. - You communicate across the room, equally fluent with C-level sponsors, technical stakeholders, and the business SMEs whose daily work is changing. text: Airtable is the no-code app platform that empowers people closest to the work to accelerate their most critical business processes. title: Director, Technical Account Management
text: Airtable is the no-code app platform that empowers people closest to the work to accelerate their most critical business processes. This role requires deep experience in platform architecture and integration, hands-on fluency with AI agent capabilities, and a clear-eyed understanding of what enterprise customers need to run Airtable as mission-critical infrastructure. # **What you'll do** - Lead and scale a high-performing team of Technical Account Managers who serve as the persistent technical authority for Premium accounts — ensuring customer environments are built to fully leverage Airtable's platform, including Field Agents, Omni, automation architecture, and the connected data structures that make intelligent workflows perform at scale. - Own the team's technical depth across Airtable's agent capabilities — including Field Agent configuration, data semantics, schema design, MCP connectivity, and automation architecture — so TAMs can guide customers through key architectural decisions and implementation. - Coach and mentor Managers and ICs, building architectural judgment and platform fluency across the team. Foster a culture of ownership and continuous learning that keeps pace with Airtable's rapid product evolution. - Establish and evolve frameworks for how TAMs assess and improve the technical health of Premium accounts — evaluating agent configurations, data semantics, integration coverage, and automation architecture against the full capability of the platform. - Engage directly with customers during critical technical projects or escalations, diagnosing root cause, proposing structural remediation, and representing Airtable as a calm, expert partner. - Partner across Sales, Customer Success, and Support to maintain clear ownership boundaries and identify high-value accounts for Premium Support — articulating the TAM value proposition in terms of architectural depth, agent reliability, and long-term technical health. - Drive program development and influence product direction by iterating on delivery models and surfacing patterns around friction, gaps, or constraints that limit how customers realize value from Airtable's capabilities. - Leverage data and KPIs (e.g., technical health scores, automation adoption, integration depth, CSAT) to inform decisions, measure success, and prioritize team focus. # **Who you are** - You have 10+ years in technical support, solution architecture, or technical account management roles, including at least 5+ years leading enterprise-facing technical teams. - You bring a solutions-architect mindset, with the ability to evaluate a customer's existing build, identify structural risk, and prescribe scalable improvements — translating complex technical requirements into concrete, actionable plans. title: Product Manager, Funnel & Activation
text: Airtable is the no-code app platform that empowers people closest to the work to accelerate their most critical business processes. More than 500,000 organizations, including 80% of the Fortune 100, rely on Airtable to transform how work gets done. #### **The Opportunity** Airtable lets teams build custom apps to run their operations without writing code. Hundreds of thousands of organizations use it to manage everything from product launches to customer pipelines to content calendars. Airtable is infinitely configurable. This is both its greatest strength and its biggest onboarding challenge: there isn't one way to use it, so there isn't one way to teach it. Our onboarding is one of the highest-leverage surfaces in the company, and it's ready for a fundamental rethink. We're not looking for someone to run incremental optimizations. We're hiring a PM to reimagine what fully personalized setup and onboarding looks like now that we have AI. Instead of a generic tour or template gallery, every user gets an onboarding path that understands their role, use case, and intent, and builds them toward their first real workflow. We want someone who can hold the ambitious vision and ship it in credible increments. # **What you'll do** - Own the full funnel from signup through sustained engagement, with a mandate to reimagine it rather than optimize it - Dramatically improve how users find success with Airtable: deeply understand who they are and what they're trying to do, and design experiences that meet them there - Lead AI-powered personalization across setup, in-product guidance, and re-engagement - Build a rigorous experimentation practice and drive fast learning cycles across the team - Partner with teams across the org to ship cohesive, adaptive experiences # **Who you are** - 4-8 years of product management experience, with meaningful time owning activation, onboarding, or retention - Customer obsessed: you start from what’s hard for our customers. text: Airtable is the no-code app platform that empowers people closest to the work to accelerate their most critical business processes. You sequence the work, hold the relationships, and make real-time decisions when plans meet reality. # **What you'll do** - Serve as the primary delivery lead for enterprise customers, owning the relationship, the plan, and the outcome from kickoff through go-live and beyond. - Run delivery across all workstreams: internal team, external partners, customer stakeholders, managing progress, blockers, and alignment simultaneously. - Own the project plan end to end: scope, schedule, budget, risk register, and RAID log across the full engagement lifecycle. - Make technical sequencing decisions when platform constraints, compliance requirements, or partner dependencies force tradeoffs. - Guide customers through AI workflow transformation, helping them move from human-run processes to AI-augmented and agent-assisted operations, and managing the organizational dynamics that come with it. - Use AI tools actively in your own delivery operations: status reporting, risk synthesis, documentation, and stakeholder communication. You lead through influence and clarity, not organizational authority. - You are genuinely fluent with AI tools, not aspirationally. You use AI in your daily delivery workflow, have an informed perspective on where agentic systems create leverage and where they introduce risk, and can help customers navigate both. - You have worked directly in Airtable or a comparable platform, not managed people who do. title: Visual Interpreter - PT Core
text: Aira is visual interpreting. We are an assistive technology company on a mission to remove barriers and make the world more accessible. We operate 24/7/365 in three languages worldwide and provide service wherever there is an internet connection. Our service is live, human-to-human professional assistance for people who are blind or have low vision. Using the powerful combination of a camera and the Aira app on someone’s device of choice, a professionally-trained visual interpreter will assist by visually interpreting what is in the camera’s view or on screen, from describing to reading, from explaining to navigating – just about anything, safely and securely. Aira is used in any industry – such as higher education, technology, retail, healthcare, transportation, and more. Our robust and growing network of partners committed to inclusion and accessibility includes airports, banks, major software companies, financial firms, retailers, and universities. With millions of calls to date, our visual interpreters empower individuals to overcome accessibility barriers every day by providing live, on-demand access to visual information. By joining this organization, you will have a major impact on the lives of the millions of people worldwide who are blind or have low vision. The Visual Interpreter is the most essential component of our service, often considered the ‘secret sauce.’ As the world’s only certified visual interpreters, Visual Interpreters are top-tier professionals dedicated to delivering an exceptional experience for members of the blind and low vision community. As a Visual Interpreter, using our proprietary technology platform, you will answer live video calls from our blind and low vision customers. You will then assist, one at a time, with real-time tasks in countless unique scenarios. Please note you will not be on camera during these live video calls. From assisting with daily personal routines to professional activities to navigating a dream journey around the globe, Visual Interpreters focus on providing live, personalized support for each customer’s unique requirements during live calls. Here is a video to show what the role encompasses and what it’s like to be a part of Aira. Working as a Visual Interpreter is unlike any other job. We've developed our own training and certification process to ensure you'll be ready and able to assist our customers accomplish any task. While our paid training will expand your communication skills, teach you to use a mix of third-party tools and proprietary technologies, and polish your customer service skills, it’s the actual real-world calls that will challenge and shape your worldview. Before submitting your cover letter and resume on Workable: Please begin by watching this informational video Please complete the Part Time Visual Interpreter Prescreen & Aptitude Objectives of this Role: Embody the Aira brand by always being helpful, consistent, creative, and kind. Provide an exceptional customer experience by utilizing training and tools (proprietary and third-party) efficiently and accurately to support blind and low vision customer needs. Contribute to the organization’s growth and success by being a core member of the Aira team by supporting other Visual Interpreters. Continue to learn and develop extensive visual interpreting capabilities via ongoing education and training. Responsibilities: Clearly and accurately present on-demand visual information to blind and low vision customers. Consistently answer calls while scheduled. Display a composed, and professional demeanor that inspires trust and supports the Aira mission. Engage and support the team by participating in team-building exercises, making helpful suggestions, encouraging other Visual Interpreters, and contributing to overall organizational growth and development. Maintain strict data privacy standards and confidentiality. Maintain regular and consistent attendance and punctuality. Follow all of Aira’s policies and procedures. Adhere to Aira’s values, beliefs, and principles. Anticipate Explorers’ needs and provide exceptional customer experience. Seek and act on constructive feedback; apply learnings from others to enhance your own abilities. Demonstrate the ability to adapt to uncertainties or changing priorities and various types of calls and situations. Work effectively with all people equitably regardless of race, color, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, age, veteran status, or marital status. Make timely and quality decisions, and improve productivity and efficiency by drawing on experience and data to anticipate potential problems before they arise. Develop and maintain effective working relationships with team members and Explorers (the name we use to refer to our customers). Set high standards of performance for self and others. Assume responsibility and accountability for completing assignments and tasks successfully. Responsibilities and activities may change or new ones may be assigned at any time with or without notice. Follow Visual Interpreter Code of Professional Conduct Requirements Key Skills and Qualifications The Visual Interpreter: Is an enthusiastic, eager, and articulate communicator. Is mission-driven, and has innate problem solving skills. Adapts well to new technological systems and processes. Is comfortable using PCs, Macs, smartphones, applications, and online platforms. Has strong spatial awareness and a keen sense of direction, with the ability to orient themselves well using 2D and 3D maps and visual cues. Has strong investigative research skills and is tenacious in the pursuit of information. Utilizes creative problem-solving skills and thrives under pressure. Possesses a strong vocabulary and knows how to utilize descriptive language effectively. Has a strong attention to detail. Qualifications: A high school diploma or GED equivalent. Be 18 years of age or older. Fluent in English. Legal right to work and presence in the United States or Canada A private workspace with no background noise, that is free from family, friends, pets, visitors, etc. Use of headphones with a noise-canceling microphone attached. It must have a USB connection. Minimum internet speed of 25 Mbps Preferred Qualifications: A background in customer service, a call center environment, or technical support. Experience working with people with disabilities or with accessibility technology. Knowledgeable of the full range of accommodations used by the blind and low vision community (e.g. JAWS). Bilingual in French or Spanish (spoken and written conversational proficiency). Schedule Requirements: Minimum 10 hours a week Weekly Commitment: A minimum of 3 days and 30 total hours of availability per week. Day Requirements: You must be available to work at least 2 weekdays (Monday through Thursday) AND at least 1 weekend day (Friday, Saturday, or Sunday). Weekend availability is mandatory. Shift Structures: You must be able to work either a straight 10-hour block within the hours of 9:00 AM and 9:00 PM PST, OR a split shift consisting of two 4–5 hour blocks with a maximum 1–2 hour gap in between. Benefits $20 base rate + time of day incentives Company issued laptop $400 technology stipend per year PTO 100% remote work - always was, always will be Supportive, integrated team environment with ongoing training opportunities Paid training All candidates will be treated fairly, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, martial status, military or veteran status, gender identity and expression, genetic information, or any other factors protected by law. Accessibility Support Aira is committed to offering reasonable accommodation to job applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to disability, please contact us at humanresources@aira.io. Aira’s Values We are powered by people We pursue excellence & hold ourselves accountable for results We embrace change and agility We act with integrity, transparency, dignity and respect We are champions of inclusion, diversity and accessibility Aira’s Operating Principles Agility: We reconsider priorities and solutions when presented with new information, scenarios, and opportunities. Focus: We operate with a plan, based on our roadmap and aligned to our priorities. Diversity: We embrace a workplace that celebrates personal differences and the way those differences make us all stronger. Scalability: We expect and demand repeatable, documented processes to replace ad-hoc operations, so we can scale growth and support career movement. Fiscal Responsibility: We make financial (or investment) decisions using radical optimism coupled with disciplined, fiscal conservatism. Transparency: We engage in open, honest, and direct, 2-way communication because we trust one another. Corporate Social Responsibility: We support the community in matters related to health, employment and independent living. This includes making our service available as broadly as possible to support these commitments.
